post.summary: Create a new job posting or talent pool.

200.description: {offer: Offer with id, pipeline_template, stages, followers}

post.description: Create a new job posting or talent pool. Request body: Body: {offer: {title (string, required), kind (string — 'job' or 'talent_pool', default 'job'), location_ids (array of integers, required), description (string, required), requirements (string, required for jobs), department_id (integer), on_site (boolean), hybrid (boolean), remote (boolean, default false), visibility_options (array), locations_question (string), locations_question_type ('single_choice' or 'multiple_choice'), locations_question_required (boolean)}}.

schema.description: Body: {offer: {title (string, required), kind (string — 'job' or 'talent_pool', default 'job'), location_ids (array of integers, required), description (string, required), requirements (string, required for jobs), department_id (integer), on_site (boolean), hybrid (boolean), remote (boolean, default false), visibility_options (array), locations_question (string), locations_question_type ('single_choice' or 'multiple_choice'), locations_question_required (boolean)}}

get.summary: Retrieve a list of candidates, with optional filtering by qualification status, offer, or search term.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of candidates to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Only return candidates created after this timestamp.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of candidate IDs to retrieve.

parameters.name: offer_id
parameters.description: Restrict to candidates assigned to a specific offer.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search across candidate name, email, and other fields.

parameters.name: with_messages
parameters.description: Include candidates who have mailbox messages.

parameters.name: with_my_messages
parameters.description: Include only candidates with messages from the current user.

get.description: Retrieve a list of candidates, with optional filtering by qualification status, offer, or search term.

Request body: Body: {candidate: {name (string, required), emails (array of strings), phones (array of strings), social_links (array of strings), links (array of strings), cover_letter (string), remote_cv_url (string)}, offers (array of integers — offer IDs to assign the candidate to)}.

schema.description: Body: {candidate: {name (string, required), emails (array of strings), phones (array of strings), social_links (array of strings), links (array of strings), cover_letter (string), remote_cv_url (string)}, offers (array of integers — offer IDs to assign the candidate to)}

admin.description: The team member who authored the note.

mentions.description: Team members mentioned in the note.

body_html.description: HTML-formatted version of the note content.

Note.description: A comment or annotation left on a candidate by a team member.

name.description: Full name of the team member.

photo_url.description: URL to the team member's avatar.

Admin.description: A team member with access to the recruiting platform.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this offer.

city.description: City where the position is based.

kind.description: Whether this represents an open position or a talent pipeline.

tags.description: Labels used to categorize this offer.

title.description: Title of the position or talent pool.

hybrid.description: Whether a hybrid work arrangement is offered.

remote.description: Whether fully remote work is an option.

status.description: Current publication state of the offer.

country.description: Country where the position is based.

on_site.description: Whether on-site work is available for this role.

location.description: Primary location name for the position.

closed_at.description: Timestamp when the offer was closed.

followers.description: Team members following activity on this offer.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the offer was created.

department.description: The department this offer belongs to.

salary_max.description: High end of the compensation range.

salary_min.description: Low end of the compensation range.

careers_url.description: Public-facing URL for the job posting on the careers site.

description.description: HTML content describing the role and responsibilities.

location_ids.description: IDs of locations associated with this offer.

published_at.description: Timestamp when the offer was made public.

requirements.description: HTML content outlining qualifications and prerequisites.

salary_period.description: Time unit for the salary figures.

education_code.description: Minimum education level for the position.

open_questions.description: Screening questions attached to the application form.

experience_code.description: Level of experience required for the role.

salary_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the salary.

careers_apply_url.description: Direct link to the application form for this offer.

pipeline_template.description: The hiring pipeline used for this offer.

employment_type_code.description: Standardized code for the employment type (e.g., full_time, part_time).

Offer.description: A job posting or talent pool within the company's recruiting pipeline.

kind.description: The stage category this step falls under.

Stage.description: A step within a hiring pipeline (e.g., Applied, Phone Screen, Interview, Offer).

scope.description: Whether the location is currently active or archived.

Location.description: A physical office or work site configured for the company.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this candidate.

tags.description: Labels applied to the candidate for filtering and organization.

links.description: Additional web links (portfolio, personal site, etc.).

cv_url.description: URL to download the candidate's resume.

emails.description: Email addresses associated with the candidate.

phones.description: Phone numbers associated with the candidate.

rating.description: Overall rating score for the candidate.

source.description: How the candidate entered the system (e.g., career_site, manual, referral).

referrer.description: Name or identifier of who referred the candidate.

photo_url.description: URL to the candidate's profile photo.

qualified.description: Whether the candidate is currently qualified (not disqualified).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the candidate record was created.

placements.description: Offers this candidate is associated with, including pipeline position.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last modification to this record.

gdpr_status.description: Current GDPR consent or data processing status.

admin_fields.description: Custom profile fields set by recruiters.

cover_letter.description: Text of the candidate's cover letter.

disqualified.description: Whether the candidate has been disqualified.

social_links.description: URLs for the candidate's social profiles (LinkedIn, GitHub, etc.).

gdpr_expires_at.description: When the candidate's GDPR consent expires.

photo_thumb_url.description: URL to a thumbnail version of the profile photo.

positive_ratings.description: Count of positive evaluations from the hiring team.

cv_original_filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded resume.

open_question_answers.description: Responses to screening questions submitted during application.

Candidate.description: An individual who has applied or been sourced for one or more positions.

stage.description: The pipeline stage the candidate currently occupies.

stage_id.description: ID of the candidate's current pipeline stage.

created_at.description: When the candidate was assigned to this offer.

disqualified.description: Whether the candidate was disqualified for this offer.

job_starts_at.description: Projected start date if the candidate is hired.

Placement.description: The association between a candidate and an offer, tracking their progress through the hiring pipeline.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer this file is attached to.

candidate_id.description: ID of the candidate this file is attached to.

Attachment.description: A file uploaded to a candidate or offer profile.

Department.description: An organizational unit within the company.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer created after approval.

department_id.description: Department the position would belong to.

created_by_admin_id.description: ID of the team member who submitted the request.

Requisition.description: A formal request to open a new position, subject to an approval workflow.

event.description: The type of change that occurred.

payload.description: Event-specific data including the affected candidate, offer, and company.

subtype.description: More specific classification (e.g., stage_changed, disqualified, requalified for candidate_moved).

WebhookEvent.description: A real-time notification delivered when recruiting data changes.

location.description: Where the interview takes place (room name, address, or video link).

description.description: Additional details or instructions for the interview.

template_id.description: Interview template used for structuring questions.

candidate_id.description: ID of the candidate being interviewed.

meeting_room_id.description: ID of the reserved meeting room, if applicable.

InterviewEvent.description: A scheduled interview session between the hiring team and a candidate.

direction.description: Whether the message was received or sent.

candidate_id.description: ID of the candidate this conversation is with.

MailboxMessage.description: An email message exchanged with a candidate through the built-in mailbox.

admin_id.description: ID of the team member who submitted the evaluation.

event_id.description: ID of the associated interview event.

InterviewResult.description: An interviewer's evaluation and feedback after conducting an interview.

DisqualifyReason.description: A predefined explanation for removing a candidate from consideration.

stages.description: Ordered list of stages in this pipeline.

PipelineTemplate.description: A reusable hiring pipeline defining the stages candidates pass through.

questions.description: Ordered list of questions for interviewers.

InterviewTemplate.description: A reusable template defining the structure and questions for interview sessions.
